mutations.catches: a tab counted as one column: the line fitting only at tab 1 is missed
the limit off by one: the comment at exactly 80 is reported
a carriage return kept: with CRLF every path ends in it and no file is read
added lines not counted: the hunk never ends and later files are lost
a context line not counted: the line after it is numbered one short

mutations.catches: every file read: the docs, data and tools lines are reported
any file under src/ read: the JSON under src/json/ is reported
the b/ prefix kept: no path matches and every finding is missed
removed lines read as added: the removed long comment is reported

mutations.mutated: return "//" in text and columns(text) > LIMIT

mutations.catches: no comment required: the long code line is reported
only tabs then spaces: the space-indented line is missed
spaces made optional: tab-indented lines are reported
literals not blanked: a { inside a logged string opens a list
no trailing comma required: an opening brace alone is reported
closed braces kept open: a one-line list argument is reported
an old side with no count read as 0: the hunk overruns into later files
a new side with no count read as 0: the last file's line is missed
